items.title: Joseph Rene Interview, 1960-09-08
items.q: That's Dipper. That's him up there. With the arrow pointing to it.

ctx.x: Yeah, well, I can see the valves in that picture, so he's playing trumpet. Yeah, yeah. What about Nicodemus? Was he there? Nicodemus? Let's see.

I believe so. I forgot those boys, but boy, you brought a picture up here. This is, this the real, Tony McCoy, I'm trying to see Lewis do. Don't you see him? Oh, yeah, that is up there. That's Dipper. That's him up there. With the arrow pointing to it. Yeah, that's, that's it right there. That's him.
What was that guy's name? Keelan or something was in there too, I think. Johnny Keely. Yeah, was, is he playing music?
